title: SandboxSpec
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

template.description: What the sandbox starts from: an image for the docker adapter, a SandboxTemplate for kubernetes, or a snapshot.

cpu.description: CPU cores. The smallest unit is 0.001 (one millicore).

items.description: A hostname without scheme or port, for example "api.linear.app".

egress.description: Hostnames the sandbox may reach through its egress proxy. Everything else is refused.

env.description: Variables of the sandbox's environment that hold no secret.

unevaluatedProperties.description: A reference to a secret, resolved at the egress proxy, never in the sandbox: "ref:<provider>/<name>".

secrets.description:
Secrets by the name of the variable that holds the placeholder in the sandbox. The egress proxy puts the real
value in on the way out, for the hosts of `egress`.

name.description: The name in the egress log, for example "wiki".

tools.description: The tools the sandbox may call. A call to any other tool is refused.

items.description: An MCP server that a sandbox may call over Streamable HTTP.

mcp.description: The MCP servers the sandbox may call. A call to any other MCP server is refused.

description:
The input of a sandbox adapter's `create` (ADR 0054): what one sandbox runs, how much it may use, and what it may
reach. Realizes SCN-FACTORY-RUNTIME-004, -006 and -007.
